authoritative_instructions.title: GABLS3 LES INTERCOMPARISON Case Description (Revised: October 6, 2008)

jax_alfa.role: independent transcription cross-check, not the original 2008 implementation

original_les_database.required_role: Cabauw tower and profiler observations plus the original eleven-member 6.25 m LES ensemble used by the 2012 paper
original_les_database.handling: remain unavailable; do not replace with SCM or later wind-energy benchmark products and do not digitize missing statistics without an explicit derived-data label

legacy_knmi_scm_observations.access_audit: The HTTPS endpoint has an expired certificate and the HTTP endpoint returns a current KNMI HTML page rather than NetCDF.
legacy_knmi_scm_observations.role: 24-hour SCM validation candidate; not verified as the observation product used by the nine-hour LES paper

later_wind_energy_benchmark.contents: nineteen submitted simulation/tendency NetCDF files for the later rotor-based wind-energy benchmark
later_wind_energy_benchmark.role: related GABLS3 diurnal-cycle benchmark, not the original 2008 eleven-member LES database or its observation archive

unresolved: The revised instructions name signed U/V components but do not explicitly define the horizontal axis orientation in text.
